name: Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) Spatial Partitioning and LOD Management
definition: Replaces flat chunk arrays with an SVO spatial hierarchy to dynamically adjust level-of-detail (LOD) based on camera distance, reducing memory footprint for 64+ chunk render distances.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree spatial partitioning replaces flat grids with hierarchical trees to enable dynamic LOD selection, reducing memory and CPU overhead by processing only visible subtrees.
